## Summary

Prepare the v0.91.7 WP-21A next-milestone closeout planning packet for the next milestone docs. This issue carries the separate closeout-planning role that v0.91.7 WP-21 explicitly deferred out of #4648 after the feature-list/TBD and v0.92 planning-truth alignment was superseded by current v0.91.8 planning authority.

## Goal

Create a review-ready next-milestone docs closeout plan that names the current v0.91.8/v0.92 planning authority, required carry-forward truth, blockers, non-claims, and handoff gates before WP-22 next-milestone review runs.

## Required Outcome

A retained v0.91.7 WP-21A closeout-planning packet exists and is integrated into the v0.91.7 release-tail sequence so WP-22 can review current next-milestone docs without consuming stale #4648 planning claims.

## Deliverables

- v0.92/v0.91.8 next-milestone docs closeout-planning packet.
- Handoff map from v0.91.7 reviewed truth into current next-milestone docs.
- Explicit blocker, supersession, and non-claim register for stale #4648-era planning assumptions.
- Updated v0.91.7 review/register references if needed so WP-22 depends on WP-21A truth.

## Acceptance Criteria

- WP-21A is distinct from closed #4648 and does not reopen #4648 scope.
- The packet identifies current next-milestone planning authority and stale/superseded inputs.
- WP-22 has a concrete review input for next-milestone docs.
- The work does not claim v0.91.7 release readiness or v0.92 activation readiness.
- Lifecycle SRP/SOR records exact validation and residual risk truth.

## Repo Inputs

- docs/milestones/v0.91.7/WP_ISSUE_WAVE_v0.91.7.yaml
- docs/milestones/v0.91.7/WBS_v0.91.7.md
- docs/milestones/v0.91.7/review/V0917_SPRINT_REVIEW_REGISTER.md
- docs/reviews/v0.91.7/remaining-sprints-5403/WP21_REVIEW_4648.md
- docs/milestones/v0.91.8/
- docs/milestones/v0.92/

## Non-goals

- Do not rerun WP-21 #4648.
- Do not execute WP-22 next-milestone review.
- Do not execute WP-23 release ceremony.
- Do not claim activation/release readiness from planning alone.

## Validation

- Focused docs/link/placeholder validation for touched planning docs.
- YAML parse for touched issue-wave files.
- git diff --check for touched files.
- Live issue truth check confirming #4648 remains closed and WP-21A is the active closeout-planning input.
title: [v0.91.7][WP-21A][planning] Prepare next milestone docs closeout plan
